response.overview: Otaku Goddess "Chicken Chop Girl" — Ili Cheng's 3D Photo Book  People often call this sexy star an "Otaku Goddess," but who says a woman's best feature has to be her only label? With over twenty different looks, there are endless moods to explore. Follow in her footsteps, step into her world, and let every movement lose you in the beauty of Taipei and Yilan.  Meticulously crafted over half a year, powered by 3D high-definition and aerial photography tech—Chicken Chop Girl presents this heartfelt gift to satisfy your every fantasy of all her different sides.
